title: The Island
summary: On Day five, Pip tells Nora and Ava what is waiting on the island.

beats.text: Day five. Pip finally told us about the island.
Her brother Jonah is twelve. Their dad rowed them there when the town fell.
Their dad went back for supplies. He never returned.
"Jonah has a lantern," Pip said. "He lights it every night."
At dusk I climbed the roof with binoculars.
Far out on the island, a tiny light flickered. Three times.
"He is alive," Ava said, gripping the paddle.
beats.speaker: ava

beats.text: But six heads broke the water near the dock.
"Nora, they come out where it is shallow. Do not use the dock."
beats.speaker: tess

beats.text: The little light went dark. A second one lit, much closer.
